prompt: Draft an email to a friend who offered to help you move, explaining that the move is smaller than expected and only an hour of help is needed. A response of around 120 words is enough.
text:
Subject: Moving Help

Hi [Friend’s Name],

Thank you again for offering to help with my move—I really appreciate it. It turns out the move is much smaller than I originally expected, so I don’t think I’ll need a full day of help after all.

If you’re still available, I could really use an extra pair of hands for about an hour to carry a few larger boxes and load the last items into the car. After that, I should be able to handle the rest on my own.

No pressure at all if your schedule has changed, but I’d be grateful to have you there. I’ll happily provide coffee, snacks, and a proper thank-you afterward!

Best,  
[Your Name]
